purpose: Measure whether sample-specific semantic narrowing and canonical knowledge supply improve a frozen speech-capable core over one direct call, and separate the information contributions of a local semantic encoder, a same-core retrieval query, their fusion, and matched prompt volume.

population.strata: 13 samples per tier across all eight Audio2Tool tiers

runtime_arms.direct_m0: One frozen-core contact with the complete 152-tool registry and original speech; no OBS state or selected knowledge.
runtime_arms.obs_semantic_retrieval: One frozen-core contact producing only a faithful English transcript and a tool-name-free desired-action retrieval query; diagnostic, not scored as a task answer.
runtime_arms.transcript_top16_use: One frozen-core task-answer contact with original speech, recipient OBS state, and decision cards for the transcript embedding's top 16 tools.
runtime_arms.model_query_top16_use: One frozen-core task-answer contact with original speech, recipient OBS state, and decision cards for the same-core retrieval-query embedding's top 16 tools.
runtime_arms.rrf_fused_top16_use: One frozen-core task-answer contact with original speech, recipient OBS state, and decision cards for RRF-60 fusion of the complete transcript and same-core-query rankings.
runtime_arms.same_stratum_shuffled_fused_use: One frozen-core task-answer contact with original speech and recipient OBS state but a different same-tier donor's fused top-16 decision cards, preserving card count and prompt class.

information_estimands.local_semantic_channel: transcript_top16_use minus direct_m0, interpreted together with transcript top-16 required-tool reachability
information_estimands.same_core_query_increment: model_query_top16_use minus transcript_top16_use while holding the local encoder, candidate count, ground, speech, and output protocol fixed
information_estimands.channel_complementarity: rrf_fused_top16_use minus each single-view USE arm

mandatory_slices: transcript, model-query, and fused top-16 required-tool reachability
paired saves, harms, ties, and confidence intervals

decision.approximately_1000_sample_expansion: not authorized unless this 104-row flight shows a stable positive agent-over-single-call gain and a positive sample-specific-evidence contrast
decision.knowledge_backtrack: if required tools are absent from top 16, revise ORG or knowledge construction; if required tools are present but answers remain wrong, revise supplied decision content or USE control before changing retrieval
decision.training_free_rl: deferred until a deployment-visible state has measured action-dependent returns; prefer a pinned open-source implementation such as Vowpal Wabbit 9.11.2 rather than a custom learner
